name: onboarding-waypoint
description: Validate actual natural spawn facing the current course entrance, punch-first visible objective, and near/far waypoint behavior.

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
assert(game:GetService('RunService'):IsStudio(),'onboarding fixture is Studio-only')
local storage=game:GetService('ServerStorage')
local world=assert(workspace:FindFirstChild('PunchWallRPG'),'game world missing')
local players=game.Players:GetPlayers() assert(#players==1,'requires one isolated player')
local p=players[1]
local function verifyEphemeralSeed(p,world,storage)
 assert(world:GetAttribute('PersistenceMode')=='EphemeralStudio' and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioDefaultEphemeral')==true and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioLiveDataOptIn')==false,'requires ephemeral Studio')
 assert(storage:GetAttribute('PunchWallAllowLiveDataStoreAccess')~=true,'live DataStore opt-in forbids Reset')
 assert(p:GetAttribute('ProfileReady')==true and p:GetAttribute('ProfilePersistenceState')=='EphemeralStudio' and p:GetAttribute('ProfileWritable')==false,'profile must be ready and ephemeral')
 return true
end
local function verifySpawnGeometry(spawnFrame,characterFrame,targetPosition,spawnSize)
 local function facing(frame)
  local delta=targetPosition-frame.Position
  local direction=Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z)
  local look=Vector3.new(frame.LookVector.X,0,frame.LookVector.Z)
  assert(direction.Magnitude>1 and look.Magnitude>.9,'missing horizontal spawn direction')
  return look.Unit:Dot(direction.Unit)
 end
 local spawnDot,characterDot=facing(spawnFrame),facing(characterFrame)
 assert(spawnDot>=.98,'SpawnLocation faces away from the actual entrance')
 assert(characterDot>=.98,'natural character faces away from the actual entrance')
 local offset=characterFrame.Position-spawnFrame.Position
 assert(math.abs(offset.X)<=spawnSize.X*.5+.5 and math.abs(offset.Z)<=spawnSize.Z*.5+.5,'natural character is outside the runtime spawn')
 assert(offset.Y>=-2 and offset.Y<=10,'natural character has not reached the spawn height')
 return {spawnDot=spawnDot,characterDot=characterDot,horizontalOffset=Vector3.new(offset.X,0,offset.Z).Magnitude,verticalOffset=offset.Y}
end
verifyEphemeralSeed(p,world,storage)
local spawn=assert(world:FindFirstChild('Punch Rookie Spawn'),'runtime spawn missing')
local entrance=assert(world.Interactables:FindFirstChild('Depth Course Entrance'),'course entrance missing')
assert(spawn:IsA('SpawnLocation') and entrance:IsA('BasePart'),'wrong spawn or entrance instance')
local deadline=os.clock()+8 local character,rootPart,humanoid
repeat
 character=p.Character rootPart=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
 if character and character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and character:GetAttribute('PunchWallSpawnPlaced')==true and rootPart and rootPart:IsA('BasePart') and humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 then break end
 task.wait(.05)
until os.clock()>=deadline
assert(character and character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and rootPart and rootPart:IsA('BasePart') and rootPart.Parent==character and humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 and character:GetAttribute('PunchWallSpawnPlaced')==true,'natural spawn placement did not complete')
assert(p.RespawnLocation==spawn,'player respawn location is not the runtime spawn')
-- Observe natural placement BEFORE ResetWorld can reposition an existing character.
local natural=verifySpawnGeometry(spawn.CFrame,rootPart.CFrame,entrance.Position,spawn.Size)
local command=storage:WaitForChild('PunchWallAutomation')
local result=command:Invoke('Reset') assert(result.ok==true,'fresh tutorial Reset failed')
assert(result.TutorialStep==1,'fresh player did not start punch-first tutorial')
local reset=verifySpawnGeometry(spawn.CFrame,rootPart.CFrame,entrance.Position,spawn.Size)
return H:JSONEncode({spawnFacingValid=true,natural=natural,reset=reset,spawnYaw=spawn.Orientation.Y,spawnPosition=tostring(spawn.Position),entrancePosition=tostring(entrance.Position),tutorial=result.TutorialStep})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local g=p.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD')
local w=g:WaitForChild('TutorialWaypoint')
local hud=g:WaitForChild('PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD')
local card=hud:WaitForChild('TutorialObjectiveHUD')
local text=card:WaitForChild('ObjectiveText')
local context=g:WaitForChild('ContextTarget')
local action=hud:WaitForChild('ContextAction')
local entrance=workspace.PunchWallRPG.Interactables['Depth Course Entrance']
local function verifyWaypointState(e,far)
 assert(e.targetMatches==true,'waypoint does not point at actual course entrance')
 assert(e.ready==true and e.step==1,'punch-first tutorial state is not ready')
 assert(e.objectiveVisible==true and string.find(e.objective,'PUNCH THE WALL',1,true),'visible objective does not teach punching')
 assert(string.find(e.distanceText,tostring(e.distance)..' studs',1,true),'waypoint distance text does not match actual distance')
 assert((far and e.distance>18 or not far and e.distance<=18),'fixture is on the wrong side of interaction distance')
 assert(e.enabled==far,'waypoint visibility does not match interaction range')
 if not far then assert(e.contextVisible==false and e.actionVisible==false,'near wall has an unrelated action prompt') end
 return true
end
local function observeWaypoint()
 local character=p.Character local rootPart=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
 local distance=rootPart and math.floor((entrance.Position-rootPart.Position).Magnitude+.5) or -1
 local label=w:FindFirstChildOfClass('TextLabel')
 return {targetMatches=w.Adornee==entrance,ready=g:GetAttribute('OnboardingWaypointReady')==true,step=g:GetAttribute('OnboardingObjectiveStep'),distance=distance,
  objectiveVisible=g.Enabled and hud.Visible and card.Visible and text.Visible and text.AbsoluteSize.X>0 and text.AbsoluteSize.Y>0,objective=text.Text,
  distanceText=label and label.Text or '',enabled=w.Enabled,contextVisible=context and context.Visible==true or false,actionVisible=action and action.Visible==true or false}
end
local deadline=os.clock()+4 local state,valid,reason
repeat
 state=observeWaypoint()
 valid,reason=pcall(verifyWaypointState,state,false)
 if valid then break end
 task.wait(.05)
until os.clock()>=deadline
assert(valid,tostring(reason)..': '..H:JSONEncode(state))
state.nearValid=true
return H:JSONEncode(state)

root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
